"max pause""},{"id":"p7s2","text":" ceiling. Scalar events (`step/start`, `tool/result`, …) sit on their own rail, and
the bar states h"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ow much silence was compressed — playback alters timing, so it says so."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Side-by-side comparison (v2).** Load a recorded `session.jsonl` next to the live one and the
theat"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"er reports where the two runs stop matching, with a seek coordinate for each side."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Upstream keeps every token's real inter-arrival gap in the session log, and is explicit that this is"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ps every token's real inter-arrival gap in the session log, and is explicit that this is deliberate:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> *"**Lossless** compact representation of one model-stream attempt"* — packages/llm/llm/src/assista"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" compact representation of one model-stream attempt"* — packages/llm/llm/src/assistant-stream.ts:1-2"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"A settled attempt keeps its per-token gaps in `dt` rather than joining the members into one string, "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"so the cadence survives on disk. Nothing in the harness replays it. This plugin does."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Or from a checkout:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the CLI reconciles it into the profile's layer list automatica"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"lly — no manual `cordis.patch.yml` edit. Restart `dsh web` and open a session: a **Theater** tab app"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ears beside Chat and Trajectory."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Control | Behavior |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| ▶ / ❚❚ | Play or pause. Playing at the end restarts from the beginning. |
| ⏴ / ⏵ | Step one frame"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" (one token) back or forward. Stepping pauses. |
| ⤾ | Restart, paused, keeping the chosen speed. |
"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"| Scrub | Seek to an absolute position. |
| Speed | 0.5× to 8×. |
| Max pause | Compress silences lo"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"nger than this (200 ms … ∞). `∞` keeps true wall-clock cadence. |
| Load earlier history | Page one "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"older window in. Playback keeps its position. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"When any silence was compressed, the transport bar says so and by how much. Playback alters the data"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"'s timing, so it tells you."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## What it replays"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Everything the browser's session window holds: assistant text, reasoning, and tool-call arguments — "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"each as its own stream — plus scalar events (`step/start`, `tool/result`, …) as markers."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Tool calls show as accumulating JSON plus the tool name**, not as full tool cards. Cards are `ui-t"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ool`'s job; this plugin is about cadence."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Limits"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **No random access.** The dsh client cannot request an arbitrary sequence: history pages backwards"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" only, one window at a time (`session.loadOlder()`), and a production tail page can hold hundreds of"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" thousands of events. So the theater replays the **loaded window** and gives you an explicit "load e"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"arlier" action rather than silently pulling an entire log into the browser.
- **Long silences are co"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"mpressed by default** (2000 ms ceiling). Set `∞` for true cadence.
- **Live sessions grow under you."},{"id":"p27s6","text":"** The window is followed, and playback keeps its position when frames are appended.
- **Seek coordi"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"nates are attempt-grained.** Since session format v2 a settled attempt occupies **one** sequence how"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"ever many tokens it holds, so a divergence report names the attempt, not the token. Ordering inside "},{"id":"p27s9","text":"an attempt comes from stream position.
- **Types are mirrored, not imported.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"-session-controller` is not published to npm, so `src/core/wire.ts` and `src/client/dsh.ts` carry st"},{"id":"p27s11","text":"ructural mirrors of the upstream shapes, each annotated with the `file:line` it was read from (pinne"},{"id":"p27s12","text":"d to dsh `639ed01` / `0.2.0-rc.2`). They are structurally compatible, so swapping them for real impo"},{"id":"p27s13","text":"rts later needs no call-site changes."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Developed against **dsh `0.2.0-rc.2`** (upstream commit `639ed01`). It reads only the public client "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"surface — `session.eventSource` and `session.loadOlder()` — because upstream removes whole client pa"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ckages between minor versions; depending on internals is not survivable."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**Reads both on-disk generations.** A settled attempt is one `assistant/message` / `assistant/attemp"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"t` carrying its packed runs in `data.stream` (format v2 and later, current is v4). Generation-0 logs"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" — the ones named `session.jsonl` with no version suffix — stored one packed row per run instead; th"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"e offline parser lifts those into the current shape, so old files still replay."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Client-only `transient` entries are ignored: upstream replaces them atomically with the settled even"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"t, and replaying both would play every token twice."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The replay core (`src/core/`) is framework-free and dsh-free, so its rules are unit-tested without a"},{"id":"p34s2","text":" browser or a harness checkout:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Test fixtures come in two kinds, for a documented reason:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **`tests/fixtures/synthetic.ts`** — hand-built records with exact `dt` arrays. Cadence assertions "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"live here.
- **`tests/fixtures/corpus-*.json`** — derived from an upstream recorded session by `make"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"-corpus-fixture.mjs`, to prove the wire mirror accepts real shapes. What the corpus can and cannot p"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"rove changed with 0.2.0, measured on `639ed01`:
- **Structure: yes.** 173 `session.v3.jsonl` snapsho"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"ts, 168 carrying a stream, 526 packed runs. Run-level `time0` and `dt` survive normalization in **al"},{"id":"p37s6","text":"l 526** (400 distinct `time0` epoch-ms values), and the longest single run holds **2047** members — "},{"id":"p37s7","text":"so the shape this plugin expands is well covered.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Offline CLI"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"The replay core is framework-free, so the same functions the browser tab uses also work in a script:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"Comparing two upstream snapshots, for example, reports where they stop matching:"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":true}
